## Load metadata
```{r}
## Load phylseq object
ps.f <- readRDS(file=here("data/phyloseq/ps_css.rds"))

input_meta <- data.frame(sample_data(ps.f)) %>%
  mutate(fetal_sex_binary = as.factor(fetal_sex_binary)) %>%
  mutate(Residency_status = as.factor(Residency_status))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Center & scale continuous variables
# so we can compare effect sizes of ega & fetal sex
# ------------------------------------------------------------

input_meta$gest_week_s <-
  scale(input_meta$Gestation_week)

input_meta$age_s <-
  scale(input_meta$Age)

input_meta$bmi_s <-
  scale(input_meta$BMI_before_pregnancy)

input_meta$parity_s <-
  (input_meta$Parity)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Sex x gestational-age interaction
# ------------------------------------------------------------

input_meta$fetal_sex_binary_num <- as.numeric(
  as.character(input_meta$fetal_sex_binary)
)

input_meta$sex_x_ega <-
  input_meta$fetal_sex_binary_num *
  as.numeric(input_meta$gest_week_s)

model_variables <- c(
  "fetal_sex_binary",
  "gest_week_s",
  "sex_x_ega",
  "age_s",
  "bmi_s",
  "parity_s",
  "Residency_status"
)

print(
  summary(
    input_meta[ , model_variables],
    useNA = "ifany"
  )
)



```
# KEGG
## abundance filtering
```{r}
# ============================================================
# ── Remove of KO's with low prevalance ──────────────────
# ============================================================
kegg_counts <- KO_pred_metagenome_unstrat
colSums_predicted_KO<-apply(kegg_counts,2,function(x) sum(as.numeric(x),na.rm=TRUE))
rel_abun<-sweep(kegg_counts,2,colSums_predicted_KO,FUN="/")
#rel_abun[!is.finite(rel_abun)]=0
hist(as.matrix(rel_abun), breaks=200, xlim = c(0.001,0.006), ylim=c(0,10000))
rel_abun_filter<-apply(rel_abun,1,function(x){
    rr<-ifelse (all(as.numeric(x)<=1E-5),FALSE,TRUE)}) # based on histogram
kegg_counts_f<-kegg_counts[rel_abun_filter,]
```


## maaslin2
```{r}
# input_data <- t(picrust.kegg)

fixed_effects <- c(
  "fetal_sex_binary",
  "gest_week_s",
  "sex_x_ega",
  "age_s",
  "bmi_s",
  "parity_s",
  "Residency_status"
)

## Fit data
fit_data <- Maaslin2(
  input_data = t(kegg_counts_f),
  input_metadata = input_meta,
  min_abundance = 0,
  min_prevalence = 0.9,
  normalization = "CLR",
  transform = "NONE",
  standardize = FALSE,
  analysis_method = "LM",
  output = file.path(outdir, "KEGG"),
  fixed_effects = fixed_effects,
  plot_heatmap = FALSE,
  plot_scatter = FALSE,
  #save_models = TRUE
  #cores = 4
)
```



## significant KEGGs
```{r}
# load maaslin2 results
all_maaslin <- read.csv(file = file.path(outdir, "KEGG", "all_results.tsv"), sep = "\t")

all_sig <- all_maaslin %>%
  filter(qval < 0.25) %>%
  filter(metadata %in% c("fetal_sex_binary", "gest_week_s", "sex_x_ega")) 

write.csv(all_sig, file = file.path(outdir, "KEGG", "KEGG_sig.csv"))

selected_kegg_ids <- all_sig$feature
```

### add labels - KEGGREST
```{r}
library(KEGGREST)
kegg_ids <- unique(selected_kegg_ids)
kegg_info <- list(kegg_ids)
for (i in 1:length(kegg_ids)) {
  q <- keggGet(kegg_ids[[i]])
  kegg_info[i] <- q
}

# out_dir <- here("data/MaasLin2/picrust2_out_css_final/outs")
# 
# dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# save list file
saveRDS(kegg_info, file = file.path(outdir, "KEGG", "kegg_list_sex.rds"))

# convert to df
kegg_df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, kegg_info), fill = TRUE)

kegg_df[,1:3] <- lapply(kegg_df[,1:3], function(x) if (is.list(x)) sapply(x, toString) else x)

# save first 3 columns (entry, symbol, name) as csv
write.csv(kegg_df[1:3], file = file.path(outdir, "KEGG", "kegg_df_sex.csv"))

# save data frame file
saveRDS(kegg_df, file = file.path(outdir, "KEGG", "kegg_df_sex.rds"))

# read in file
kegg_df <- read.csv(file = file.path(outdir, "KEGG", "kegg_df_sex.csv"), row.names = 1)

# Rename a specific column by matching its old name
names(kegg_df)[names(kegg_df) == "ENTRY"] <- "feature"


all_sig_final <- merge(kegg_df, all_sig, by = "feature")

# save all sig final
write.csv(all_sig_final, file = file.path(outdir, "KEGG", "kegg_df_sex.csv"))
```

## plot sig keggs - sex, sex + gest week, interaction
```{r}
# save all sig final
all_sig_final <- read.csv(file = file.path(outdir, "KEGG", "kegg_df_sex.csv"), row.names = 1)

all_sig_sex_int <- all_sig_final %>%
  filter(metadata %in% c("fetal_sex_binary", "sex_x_ega"))
```

```{r}
kegg_significance_groups <- all_sig_final%>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    metadata = trimws(as.character(metadata))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    metadata %in% c(
      "fetal_sex_binary",
      "gest_week_s",
      "sex_x_ega"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    feature,
    metadata
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sig_sex = metadata == "fetal_sex_binary",
    sig_gest_week = metadata == "gest_week_s",
    sig_interaction = metadata == "sex_x_ega"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(feature) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    sig_sex = any(sig_sex),
    sig_gest_week = any(sig_gest_week),
    sig_interaction = any(sig_interaction),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    significance_group = dplyr::case_when(
      # Significant interaction takes priority,
      # regardless of whether main effects are also significant
      sig_interaction ~
        "Fetal sex x EGA interaction",

      # Sex only
      sig_sex &
        !sig_gest_week &
        !sig_interaction ~
        "Fetal sex",

      # EGA only
      !sig_sex &
        sig_gest_week &
        !sig_interaction ~
        "EGA",

      # Both main effects significant, but interaction not significant
      sig_sex &
        sig_gest_week &
        !sig_interaction ~
        "Fetal sex + EGA",

      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

kegg_significance_groups <- kegg_significance_groups %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    significance_group = factor(
      significance_group,
      levels = c(
        "Fetal sex",
        "EGA",
        "Fetal sex + EGA",
        "Fetal sex x EGA interaction"
      )
    )
  )

kegg_significance_groups %>%
  dplyr::count(
    significance_group,
    name = "n_keggs"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(n_keggs)
  )
```

## plot sig keggs - final
```{r}
library(grid)
# ============================================================
# Keep only the four significance groups to plot
# ============================================================

groups_to_plot <- c(
  "Fetal sex",
  "Fetal sex + EGA",
#  "Fetal sex x EGA interaction"
)

# don't plot gestational week coefficients 
kegg_df_plot <- all_sig_final %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    kegg_significance_groups %>%
      dplyr::select(
        feature,
        significance_group
      ),
    by = "feature"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    significance_group %in% groups_to_plot
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    significance_group = factor(
      significance_group,
      levels = groups_to_plot
    ),

    neg_log10_q = -log10(qval),

    direction = dplyr::if_else(
      coef >= 0,
      "Positive",
      "Negative"
    )
  )

group_colors <- c(
  "Fetal sex" = "#E69F00",
  "Fetal sex + EGA" = "#7A5195",
 # "Interaction only" = "#CC79A7",
  "Fetal sex x EGA interaction" = "#0072B2"
)

kegg_df_plot <- kegg_df_plot %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    significance_group,
    coef
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    plot_label = paste(
      significance_group,
      SYMBOL,
      sep = "___GROUP___"
    ),

    plot_label = factor(
      plot_label,
      levels = unique(plot_label)
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# Colors for the actual MaAsLin terms being plotted
# ============================================================

metadata_colors <- c(
  "Fetal sex" = "#BC80BD",
  "EGA" = "#0072B2"
)
# ============================================================
# Prepare plotting data
#
# Keep:
#   - Sex only
#   - EGA only
#   - Sex + EGA
#
# Exclude significant interactions
# ============================================================

kegg_df_plot_filtered <- kegg_df_plot %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    significance_group %in% c(
      "Fetal sex",
    #  "EGA",
      "Fetal sex + EGA"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    metadata %in% c(
      "fetal_sex_binary",
      "gest_week_s"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    metadata = dplyr::recode(
      metadata,
      "fetal_sex_binary" = "Fetal sex",
      "gest_week_s" = "EGA"
    ),
    metadata = factor(
      metadata,
      levels = c(
        "Fetal sex",
        "EGA"
      )
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# Set enzyme ordering
#
# Each NAME_short gets exactly one y-axis position.
# ============================================================

kegg_name_order <- kegg_df_plot_filtered %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    SYMBOL
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_coef = mean(
      coef,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    mean_coef
  )

kegg_df_plot_filtered <- kegg_df_plot_filtered %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    plot_label = factor(
      SYMBOL,
      levels = kegg_name_order$SYMBOL
    )
  )

p_kegg_groups <- ggplot(
  kegg_df_plot_filtered,
  aes(
    x = coef,
    y = plot_label,
    color = metadata
  )
) +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Lollipop stems
  #
  # If an enzyme has both sex and EGA associations,
  # both stems/dots occupy the same y-axis line.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = 0,
      xend = coef,
      y = plot_label,
      yend = plot_label,
      color = metadata
    ),
    linewidth = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.35,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  geom_point(
    aes(
      size = neg_log10_q,
      color = metadata
    ),
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = metadata_colors,
    breaks = c(
      "Fetal sex",
      "EGA"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_size_continuous(
    range = c(
      2,
      5
    ),
    name = expression(-log[10](q))
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "MaAsLin coefficient",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Significant association",
    size = expression(-log[10](q))
  ) +

  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      order = 1,
      title.position = "top",
      override.aes = list(
        size = 6,
        alpha = 1
    )
    ),
    size = guide_legend(
      order = 2,
      title.position = "top"
    )
  ) +
  
  theme_classic() +
  
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.direction = "vertical",
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 16
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 14
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 13
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
       size = 12
     ),
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 14
    )
  )
  # +
  # 
  # theme(
  #   legend.position = "bottom",
  #   legend.box = "horizontal",
  # 


p_kegg_groups

ggsave(
  file.path(
    plotdir,
    "kegg_significance_groups_lollipop.png"
  ),
  plot = p_kegg_groups,
  dpi = 600,
  width = 8,
  height =8,
  units = "in",
  limitsize = FALSE
)
```





## trimester plots - final
```{r}
library(ggh4x)

all_sig_sex_int <- all_sig_final %>%
  filter(metadata == "sex_x_ega")

ECs_to_plot <- all_sig_sex_int$feature
# ============================================================
# 5. Extract coefficients needed to calculate
#    conditional fetal-sex effect
#
# NOTE:
# gest_week_s determines which ECs are included/grouped,
# but it is NOT part of the conditional fetal-sex equation.
#
# Conditional sex effect =
# beta_sex + beta_sex_ega * gest_week_s
# ============================================================

sex_coefficients <- all_maaslin %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    metadata = trimws(as.character(metadata)),
    feature = as.character(feature),
    coef = as.numeric(coef)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    metadata %in% c(
      "fetal_sex_binary",
      "sex_x_ega"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    feature,
    metadata,
    coef
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = metadata,
    values_from = coef
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    beta_sex = fetal_sex_binary,
    beta_sex_ega = sex_x_ega
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    feature %in% ECs_to_plot
  )


# ============================================================
# 6. Check that all selected ECs have coefficients
# ============================================================

missing_coefs <- setdiff(
  ECs_to_plot,
  sex_coefficients$feature
)

if (length(missing_coefs) > 0) {
  warning(
    length(missing_coefs),
    " selected ECs are missing sex/interaction coefficients."
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 8. Participant-level metadata
# ============================================================

participant_meta <- input_meta %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(
    "sample_id"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    fetal_sex = dplyr::case_when(
      fetal_sex_binary == 0 ~ "Male",
      fetal_sex_binary == 1 ~ "Female",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    fetal_sex = factor(
      fetal_sex,
      levels = c(
        "Male",
        "Female"
      )
    ),

    trimester = dplyr::case_when(
      Gestation_week < 14 ~
        "Trimester 1",

      Gestation_week >= 14 &
        Gestation_week < 28 ~
        "Trimester 2",

      Gestation_week >= 28 ~
        "Trimester 3",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    trimester = factor(
      trimester,
      levels = c(
        "Trimester 1",
        "Trimester 2",
        "Trimester 3"
      )
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# Add EC annotations/significance group to coefficient table
# ============================================================

EC_annotation_df <- EC_df_plot %>%
  dplyr::select(
    feature,
    SYMBOL,
    significance_group
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

sex_coefficients <- sex_coefficients %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    EC_annotation_df,
    by = "feature"
  )

# ============================================================
# 9. Generate participant-specific conditional sex effects
#
# THIS MUST BE REBUILT HERE.
#
# Do not reuse sex_effect_participant from the first
# sex_x_ega-only plot.
# ============================================================

sex_effect_participant <- sex_coefficients %>%
  tidyr::crossing(
    participant_meta
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    effective_sex_coef =
      beta_sex +
      beta_sex_ega * as.numeric(gest_week_s)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(trimester),
    !is.na(fetal_sex),
    !is.na(effective_sex_coef),
    !is.na(significance_group),
    !is.na(SYMBOL)
  )


# ============================================================
# 10. Verify that all significance groups are represented
# ============================================================

group_counts <- sex_effect_participant %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    feature,
    significance_group
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(
    significance_group,
    name = "n_ECs"
  )

print(group_counts)


# ============================================================
# 11. Define EC ordering
#
# Use the sex × EGA coefficient as the ordering variable
# when available.
#
# Because the plotting ID includes significance group,
# ECs remain separated correctly across facet groups.
# ============================================================

plot_order_df <- sex_coefficients %>%
  dplyr::select(
    feature,
    SYMBOL,
    significance_group,
    beta_sex_ega
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    significance_group,
    beta_sex_ega
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    plot_id = paste(
      significance_group,
      feature,
      sep = "___GROUP___"
    )
  )

plot_levels <- unique(
  plot_order_df$plot_id
)


# ============================================================
# 12. Apply plotting ID/order
# ============================================================

sex_effect_participant <- sex_effect_participant %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    plot_id = paste(
      significance_group,
      feature,
      sep = "___GROUP___"
    ),

    plot_id = factor(
      plot_id,
      levels = plot_levels
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 13. Taxonomy display labels
# ============================================================

plot_labels <- setNames(
  plot_order_df$SYMBOL,
  plot_order_df$plot_id
)


# ============================================================
# 14. Calculate mean conditional effect within trimester
# ============================================================

sex_effect_participant <- sex_effect_participant %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    plot_id,
    trimester
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    mean_effective_coef = mean(
      effective_sex_coef,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    mean_direction = dplyr::if_else(
      mean_effective_coef < 0,
      "Mean < 0",
      "Mean > 0"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()


# ============================================================
# Dummy data for significance-group legend
# ============================================================

legend_group_df <- sex_effect_participant %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    significance_group
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(significance_group)
  )

# ============================================================
# Plot
# ============================================================

p <- ggplot(
  sex_effect_participant,
  aes(
    x = effective_sex_coef,
    y = plot_id
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(
      fill = mean_direction
    ),
    width = 0.65,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +

  geom_jitter(
    width = 0,
    height = 0.08,
    size = 1,
    alpha = 0.4,
    color = "grey30"
  ) +

  # Invisible points used only to create significance-group legend
  geom_point(
    data = legend_group_df,
    aes(
      x = Inf,
      y = Inf,
      color = significance_group
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha = 0
  ) +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    color = "darkgrey",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  ggh4x::facet_grid2(
    rows = vars(significance_group),
    cols = vars(trimester),
    scales = "free_y",
    space = "free_y",
    # strip = ggh4x::strip_themed(
    #   background_y = ggh4x::elem_list_rect(
    #     fill = unname(group_colors),
    #     color = NA
    #   ),
    #   text_y = ggh4x::elem_list_text(
    #     colour = "transparent",
    #     size = 1,
    #     hjust = 0.5,
    #     vjust = 0.5
    #   )
    # )
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Mean < 0" = "#50B93A",
      "Mean > 0" = "#9C7FB9"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = group_colors,
    breaks = levels(
      sex_effect_participant$significance_group
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = plot_labels
  ) +

  labs(
```

## plots - fig 3c
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# ============================================================
# 1. Load pathway results
# ============================================================

plot_df <- read_excel(path = file.path(outdir, "KEGG", "microbiomeprofiler.xlsx"), col_names = TRUE)

# ============================================================
# 2. Load fetal-sex KEGG coefficients
# ============================================================

fetal_sex <- all_sig_sex_int

# ============================================================
# 3. Split pathway geneID column into individual KEGG IDs
# ============================================================

kegg_long <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    geneID = as.character(geneID)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::separate_rows(
    geneID,
    sep = "/"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    geneID = trimws(geneID)
  )

# ============================================================
# 4. Join fetal-sex coefficients
# ============================================================

kegg_long <- kegg_long %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    fetal_sex %>%
      dplyr::select(
        feature,
        coef
      ) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(),
    by = c(
      "geneID" = "feature"
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 5. Classify KEGG IDs by coefficient direction
# ============================================================

kegg_long <- kegg_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    direction = dplyr::case_when(
      coef > 0 ~ "Positive",
      coef < 0 ~ "Negative",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 6. Count positive/negative KEGG IDs in each pathway
#
# Use Description here so it matches the y-axis of the
# enrichment plot.
# ============================================================

direction_counts <- kegg_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(direction)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    Description,
    geneID,
    direction
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(
    Description,
    direction,
    name = "n_keggs"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    Description,
    direction = c(
      "Positive",
      "Negative"
    ),
    fill = list(
      n_keggs = 0
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 7. Define pathway ordering ONCE
# ============================================================

pathway_levels <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    zScore
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(
    Description
  ) %>%
  unique()

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Pathway = factor(
      Description,
      levels = pathway_levels
    ),

    Count = factor(
      Count,
      levels = c(
        3,
        4
      )
    )
  )

direction_counts <- direction_counts %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Pathway = factor(
      Description,
      levels = pathway_levels
    ),

    direction = factor(
      direction,
      levels = c(
        "Positive",
        "Negative"
      )
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 8. Original enrichment dot plot
# ============================================================

p_dot <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = zScore,
    y = Pathway
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      size = Count,
      color = p.adjust
    ),
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_size_manual(
    name = "Count",
    values = c(
      "3" = 4,
      "4" = 7
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_gradient(
    low = "#8C47D7",
    high = "#619486"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(
      0,
      NA
    ),
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(
        0,
        0.05
      )
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Z-score",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Adjusted p-value"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 14
    ),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 14
    ),

    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 14
    ))

# ============================================================
# 9. Positive/negative KEGG bar plot
# ============================================================

direction_colors <- c(
  "Positive" = "#9C7FB9",
  "Negative" = "#50B93A"
)

p_bar <- ggplot(
  direction_counts,
  aes(
    x = n_keggs,
    y = Pathway,
    fill = direction
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = direction_colors,
    name = "Female fetal-sex association"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(),
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(
        0,
        0.05
      )
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of KEGGs",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    # Pathway labels are already shown on left plot
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 14
    ),

    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 14
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 10. Combine plots
# ============================================================

p_combined <- p_dot + p_bar +
  patchwork::plot_layout(
    widths = c(
      2.2,
      1
    ),
    guides = "collect"
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

p_combined

direction_counts_diverging <- direction_counts %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    plot_count = dplyr::if_else(
      direction == "Negative",

    )
  )

p_bar <- ggplot(
```

## add labels - KEGGREST
```{r}
library(KEGGREST)

# Convert list to character vector
kegg_ids <- unique(unlist(selected_kegg_ids))

library(KEGGREST)
library(stringr)

# Convert PICRUSt-style EC IDs to KEGG format
kegg_ids <- sub(
  "^EC\\.",
  "ec:",
  kegg_ids
)

head(kegg_ids)

kegg_info <- vector(
  "list",
  length(kegg_ids)
)

names(kegg_info) <- kegg_ids

for (i in seq_along(kegg_ids)) {

  message(
    i,
    "/",
    length(kegg_ids),
    ": ",
    kegg_ids[i]
  )

  q <- tryCatch(
    keggGet(kegg_ids[i]),
    error = function(e) {
      warning(
        "Failed for ",
        kegg_ids[i],
        ": ",
        conditionMessage(e)
      )
      return(NULL)
    }
  )

  if (!is.null(q) && length(q) > 0) {

    entry <- q[[1]]

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Detect transferred EC entries
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    transferred_to <- NA_character_

    if (!is.null(entry$NAME)) {

      name_text <- paste(
        entry$NAME,
        collapse = " "
      )

      transferred_match <- stringr::str_match(
        name_text,
        "(?i)Transferred to EC[ :]*([0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+)"
      )

      if (!is.na(transferred_match[1, 2])) {
        transferred_to <- transferred_match[1, 2]
      }
    }

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # If transferred, query the new EC number
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (!is.na(transferred_to)) {

      new_kegg_id <- paste0(
        "ec:",
        transferred_to
      )

      message(
        "  Transferred to ",
        new_kegg_id
      )

      q_new <- tryCatch(
        keggGet(new_kegg_id),
        error = function(e) {
          warning(
            "Failed transferred EC ",
            new_kegg_id,
            ": ",
            conditionMessage(e)
          )
          return(NULL)
        }
      )

      if (!is.null(q_new) && length(q_new) > 0) {

        new_entry <- q_new[[1]]

        # Keep original and transferred IDs for traceability
        new_entry$ORIGINAL_EC <- kegg_ids[i]
        new_entry$TRANSFERRED_TO <- new_kegg_id

        kegg_info[[i]] <- new_entry

      } else {

        entry$ORIGINAL_EC <- kegg_ids[i]
        entry$TRANSFERRED_TO <- new_kegg_id

        kegg_info[[i]] <- entry
      }

    } else {

      entry$ORIGINAL_EC <- kegg_ids[i]
      entry$TRANSFERRED_TO <- NA_character_

      kegg_info[[i]] <- entry
    }
  }

  Sys.sleep(0.2)
}
```

```{r}
EC_significance_groups <- all_sig_final %>%
 dplyr::distinct(
    feature,
    metadata
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sig_sex = metadata == "fetal_sex_binary",
    sig_gest_week = metadata == "gest_week_s",
    sig_interaction = metadata == "sex_x_ega"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(feature) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    sig_sex = any(sig_sex),
    sig_gest_week = any(sig_gest_week),
    sig_interaction = any(sig_interaction),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    significance_group = dplyr::case_when(

      # Significant interaction takes priority,
      # regardless of whether main effects are also significant
      sig_interaction ~
        "Fetal sex x EGA interaction",

      # Sex only
      sig_sex &
        !sig_gest_week &
        !sig_interaction ~
        "Fetal sex",

      # EGA only
      !sig_sex &
        sig_gest_week &
        !sig_interaction ~
        "EGA",

      # Both main effects significant, but interaction not significant
      sig_sex &
        sig_gest_week &
        !sig_interaction ~
        "Fetal sex + EGA",

      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

EC_significance_groups <- EC_significance_groups %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    significance_group = factor(
      significance_group,
      levels = c(
        "Fetal sex",
        "EGA",
        "Fetal sex + EGA",
        "Fetal sex x EGA interaction"
      )
    )
  )

EC_significance_groups %>%
  dplyr::count(
    significance_group,
    name = "n_ECs"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(n_ECs)
  )
```

```{r}
library(grid)
# ============================================================
# Keep only the four significance groups to plot
# ============================================================

groups_to_plot <- c(
  "Fetal sex",
  "Fetal sex + EGA",
  "Fetal sex x EGA interaction"
)

# don't plot gestational week coefficients 

# ============================================================
# Prepare plotting dataframe
# ============================================================

EC_df_plot <- all_sig_final %>%
  mutate(
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Short NAME
    # KEGG NAME often contains many synonyms separated by ;
    # Keep only the first name
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    NAME_first = str_extract(NAME, "^[^;]+"),
    NAME_first = str_squish(NAME_first),
    
    # Replace specific long enzyme name with shorter label
    NAME_first = case_when(
      NAME_first ==
        "galactofuranosylgalactofuranosylrhamnosyl-N-acetylglucosaminyl-diphospho-decaprenol beta-1,5/1,6-galactofuranosyltransferase" ~
        "β-1,5/1,6-galactofuranosyltransferase",
      TRUE ~ NAME_first
    ),


    # Shorten very long first names
    NAME_short = str_trunc(
      NAME_first,
      width = 45,
      side = "right",
      ellipsis = "..."
    ),

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Clean EC label
    # EC.2.4.99.16 -> EC 2.4.99.16
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    EC_label = str_replace(
      feature,
      "^EC\\.",
      "EC "
    ),

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Broad enzyme class
    #
    # Example:
    # "Transferases;, Glycosyltransferases;, ..."
    # becomes
    # "Transferases"
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    CLASS_broad = str_extract(
      CLASS,
      "^[^;]+"
    ),
    CLASS_broad = str_squish(CLASS_broad),

    # Optional more detailed hierarchy
    CLASS_detail = str_replace_all(
      CLASS,
      ";,\\s*",
      " > "
    ),
    CLASS_detail = str_remove(
      CLASS_detail,
      ";\\s*$"
    ),

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Clean metadata names
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    metadata = recode(
      metadata,
      "fetal_sex_binary" = "Fetal sex",
      "gest_week_s" = "EGA",
      "sex_x_ega" = "Sex × EGA interaction"
    ),

    metadata = factor(
      metadata,
      levels = c(
        "Fetal sex",
        "EGA",
        "Sex × EGA interaction"
      )
    ),

    # Useful for optional point-size mapping
    neg_log10_q = -log10(qval),

    direction = if_else(
      coef >= 0,
      "Positive",
      "Negative"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    EC_significance_groups %>%
      dplyr::select(
        feature,
        significance_group
      ),
    by = "feature"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    significance_group %in% groups_to_plot
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    significance_group = factor(
      significance_group,
      levels = groups_to_plot
    ),

    neg_log10_q = -log10(qval),

    direction = dplyr::if_else(
      coef >= 0,
      "Positive",
      "Negative"
    )
  )

EC_df_plot2 <- EC_df_plot %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    NAME_short = dplyr::case_when(
      feature == "EC.3.1.22.4" ~ "crossover junction endodeoxyribonuclease",
      TRUE ~ NAME_short
    )
  )

group_colors <- c(
  "Fetal sex" = "#E69F00",
  "Fetal sex + EGA" = "#7A5195",
  "Interaction only" = "#CC79A7",
  "EGA" = "#0072B2"
)
```

## trimester plots - final
```{r}
library(ggh4x)

all_sig_sex_int <- all_sig_final %>%
  filter(metadata == "sex_x_ega")

ECs_to_plot <- all_sig_sex_int$feature
# ============================================================
# 5. Extract coefficients needed to calculate
#    conditional fetal-sex effect
#
# NOTE:
# gest_week_s determines which ECs are included/grouped,
# but it is NOT part of the conditional fetal-sex equation.
#
# Conditional sex effect =
# beta_sex + beta_sex_ega * gest_week_s
# ============================================================

sex_coefficients <- all_maaslin %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    metadata = trimws(as.character(metadata)),
    feature = as.character(feature),
    coef = as.numeric(coef)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    metadata %in% c(
      "fetal_sex_binary",
      "sex_x_ega"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    feature,
    metadata,
    coef
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = metadata,
    values_from = coef
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    beta_sex = fetal_sex_binary,
    beta_sex_ega = sex_x_ega
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    feature %in% ECs_to_plot
  )


# ============================================================
# 6. Check that all selected ECs have coefficients
# ============================================================

missing_coefs <- setdiff(
  ECs_to_plot,
  sex_coefficients$feature
)

if (length(missing_coefs) > 0) {
  warning(
    length(missing_coefs),
    " selected ECs are missing sex/interaction coefficients."
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 8. Participant-level metadata
# ============================================================

participant_meta <- input_meta %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(
    "sample_id"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    fetal_sex = dplyr::case_when(
      fetal_sex_binary == 0 ~ "Male",
      fetal_sex_binary == 1 ~ "Female",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    fetal_sex = factor(
      fetal_sex,
      levels = c(
        "Male",
        "Female"
      )
    ),

    trimester = dplyr::case_when(
      Gestation_week < 14 ~
        "Trimester 1",

      Gestation_week >= 14 &
        Gestation_week < 28 ~
        "Trimester 2",

      Gestation_week >= 28 ~
        "Trimester 3",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    trimester = factor(
      trimester,
      levels = c(
        "Trimester 1",
        "Trimester 2",
        "Trimester 3"
      )
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# Add EC annotations/significance group to coefficient table
# ============================================================

EC_annotation_df <- EC_df_plot %>%
  dplyr::select(
    feature,
    NAME_short,
    significance_group
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

sex_coefficients <- sex_coefficients %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    EC_annotation_df,
    by = "feature"
  )

# ============================================================
# 9. Generate participant-specific conditional sex effects
#
# THIS MUST BE REBUILT HERE.
#
# Do not reuse sex_effect_participant from the first
# sex_x_ega-only plot.
# ============================================================

sex_effect_participant <- sex_coefficients %>%
  tidyr::crossing(
    participant_meta
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    effective_sex_coef =
      beta_sex +
      beta_sex_ega * as.numeric(gest_week_s)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(trimester),
    !is.na(fetal_sex),
    !is.na(effective_sex_coef),
    !is.na(significance_group),
    !is.na(NAME_short)
  )


# ============================================================
# 10. Verify that all significance groups are represented
# ============================================================

group_counts <- sex_effect_participant %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    feature,
    significance_group
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(
    significance_group,
    name = "n_ECs"
  )

print(group_counts)


# ============================================================
# 11. Define EC ordering
#
# Use the sex × EGA coefficient as the ordering variable
# when available.
#
# Because the plotting ID includes significance group,
# ECs remain separated correctly across facet groups.
# ============================================================

plot_order_df <- sex_coefficients %>%
  dplyr::select(
    feature,
    NAME_short,
    significance_group,
    beta_sex_ega
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    significance_group,
    beta_sex_ega
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    plot_id = paste(
      significance_group,
      feature,
      sep = "___GROUP___"
    )
  )

plot_levels <- unique(
  plot_order_df$plot_id
)


# ============================================================
# 12. Apply plotting ID/order
# ============================================================

sex_effect_participant <- sex_effect_participant %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    plot_id = paste(
      significance_group,
      feature,
      sep = "___GROUP___"
    ),

    plot_id = factor(
      plot_id,
      levels = plot_levels
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 13. Taxonomy display labels
# ============================================================

plot_labels <- setNames(
  plot_order_df$NAME_short,
  plot_order_df$plot_id
)


# ============================================================
# 14. Calculate mean conditional effect within trimester
# ============================================================

sex_effect_participant <- sex_effect_participant %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    plot_id,
    trimester
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    mean_effective_coef = mean(
      effective_sex_coef,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    mean_direction = dplyr::if_else(
      mean_effective_coef < 0,
      "Mean < 0",
      "Mean > 0"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()


# ============================================================
# Dummy data for significance-group legend
# ============================================================

legend_group_df <- sex_effect_participant %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    significance_group
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(significance_group)
  )

# ============================================================
# Plot
# ============================================================

p <- ggplot(
  sex_effect_participant,
  aes(
    x = effective_sex_coef,
    y = plot_id
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(
      fill = mean_direction
    ),
    width = 0.65,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +

  geom_jitter(
    width = 0,
    height = 0.08,
    size = 1,
    alpha = 0.4,
    color = "grey30"
  ) +

  # Invisible points used only to create significance-group legend
  geom_point(
    data = legend_group_df,
    aes(
      x = Inf,
      y = Inf,
      color = significance_group
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha = 0
  ) +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    color = "darkgrey",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  ggh4x::facet_grid2(
    rows = vars(significance_group),
    cols = vars(trimester),
    scales = "free_y",
    space = "free_y",
    # strip = ggh4x::strip_themed(
    #   background_y = ggh4x::elem_list_rect(
    #     fill = unname(group_colors),
    #     color = NA
    #   ),
    #   text_y = ggh4x::elem_list_text(

    #     size = 1,
    #     hjust = 0.5,

    # )
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Mean < 0" = "#50B93A",
      "Mean > 0" = "#9C7FB9"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = group_colors,
    breaks = levels(
      sex_effect_participant$significance_group
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = plot_labels
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Conditional fetal sex effect (Female - Male)",
    y = "",
    color = "Significant association",
    fill = "Mean coefficient"
  ) +

  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
```

# Pathways
## abundance filtering
```{r}
# ============================================================
# ── Remove of MetaCyc's with low prevalance ─────────────────
# ============================================================
pathway_Sample <- path_abun_unstrat
colSums_pathways<-apply(pathway_Sample,2,function(x) sum(as.numeric(x),na.rm=TRUE))
rel_abun<-sweep(pathway_Sample,2,colSums_pathways,FUN="/")
#rel_abun[!is.finite(rel_abun)]=0
hist(as.numeric(unlist(rel_abun)), breaks=20, xlim = c(0.001,0.035), ylim=c(0,10000))
rel_abun_filter<-apply(rel_abun,1,function(x){
    rr<-ifelse (all(as.numeric(x)<=1E-3),FALSE,TRUE)}) # based on histogram
pathway_Sample<-pathway_Sample[rel_abun_filter,]
```

```{r}
pathways_significance_groups <- all_sig_final %>%
 dplyr::distinct(
    feature,
    metadata
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sig_sex = metadata == "fetal_sex_binary",
    sig_gest_week = metadata == "gest_week_s",
    sig_interaction = metadata == "sex_x_ega"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(feature) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    sig_sex = any(sig_sex),
    sig_gest_week = any(sig_gest_week),
    sig_interaction = any(sig_interaction),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    significance_group = dplyr::case_when(

      # Significant interaction takes priority,
      # regardless of whether main effects are also significant
      sig_interaction ~
        "Fetal sex x EGA interaction",

      # Sex only
      sig_sex &
        !sig_gest_week &
        !sig_interaction ~
        "Fetal sex",

      # EGA only
      !sig_sex &
        sig_gest_week &
        !sig_interaction ~
        "EGA",

      # Both main effects significant, but interaction not significant
      sig_sex &
        sig_gest_week &
        !sig_interaction ~
        "Fetal sex + EGA",

      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

pathways_significance_groups <- pathways_significance_groups %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    significance_group = factor(
      significance_group,
      levels = c(
        "Fetal sex",
        "EGA",
        "Fetal sex + EGA",
        "Fetal sex x EGA interaction"
      )
    )
  )

pathways_significance_groups %>%
  dplyr::count(
    significance_group,
    name = "n_pathwayss"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(n_pathwayss)
  )
```

```{r}
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    significance_group = factor(
      significance_group,
      levels = groups_to_plot
    ),

    direction = dplyr::if_else(
      coef >= 0,
      "Positive",
      "Negative"
    )
  )

group_colors <- c(

)

    coef
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    plot_label = paste(

      description,
      sep = "___GROUP___"
    ),

    plot_label = factor(
      plot_label,
      levels = unique(plot_label)
    )
  )

p_pathways_groups <- ggplot(
  pathways_df_plot,
  aes(
    x = coef,
    y = plot_label,
    color = significance_group
  )
) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = 0,
      xend = coef,
      y = plot_label,
      yend = plot_label
    ),
    color = "gray",
    linewidth = 0.5,
    inherit.aes = FALSE

  ) +

    ),
    legend.text = element_text(

  theme(
    
    # Keep column facet labels, e.g. trimester

      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    strip.text.y = element_blank(),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 12
    ),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 14
    ),

    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 14
    )
  )

p_pathways_groups

ggsave(
```

## trimester plots
```{r}
# ============================================================
# 1. Put MaAsLin2 coefficients into long format
#
# Assumes:
#   metadata   / coef
#   metadata.1 / coef.1
#   metadata.2 / coef.2
#
# correspond to the three terms in filt_data.
# ============================================================

# load filtered maaslin2 data
pathways_abundance <- read.csv(file = file.path(outdir, "pathways", "features", "filtered_data.tsv"), sep = "\t", row.names = 1)
all_sig_final <- all_sig_annotated
# ============================================================
# 1. Extract gestational-age and sex x EGA coefficients
# ============================================================

unique(all_maaslin$metadata)

table(all_maaslin$metadata, useNA = "ifany")

pathways_coefficients <- all_maaslin %>%
  mutate(
    metadata = trimws(as.character(metadata)),
    feature = as.character(feature),
    coef = as.numeric(coef)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    metadata %in% c(
      "gest_week_s",
      "sex_x_ega"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    feature,
    metadata,
    coef
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = metadata,
    values_from = coef
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    beta_ega = gest_week_s,
    beta_sex_ega = sex_x_ega
  )

colnames(pathways_coefficients)

pathwayss_to_plot <- unique(all_sig_final$feature)

unique(all_sig_final$metadata)
colnames(all_sig_final)

pathways_coeffs_sig <- pathways_coefficients %>%
  filter(feature %in% pathwayss_to_plot)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 2. Convert pathways abundance matrix to long format
# ============================================================

pathways_long <- as.data.frame(
  pathways_abundance,
  check.names = FALSE
) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -sample_id,
    names_to = "feature",
    values_to = "abundance"
  )
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 3. Prepare sample metadata
# ============================================================

metadata_plot <- input_meta %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  mutate(
    trimester = case_when(
      Gestation_week < 14 ~ "Trimester 1",
      Gestation_week >= 14 & Gestation_week < 28 ~ "Trimester 2",
      Gestation_week >= 28 ~ "Trimester 3",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    trimester = factor(
      trimester,
      levels = c(
        "Trimester 1",
        "Trimester 2",
        "Trimester 3"
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 4. Adjust abundance for EGA and Sex x EGA
# ============================================================

plot_data <- pathways_long %>%
  inner_join(
    metadata_plot,
    by = "sample_id"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    pathways_coefficients,
    by = "feature"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    abundance_adjusted =
      abundance -
      beta_ega * gest_week_s -
      beta_sex_ega * sex_x_ega
  )

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    fetal_sex = case_when(
      fetal_sex_binary == 0 ~ "Male",
      fetal_sex_binary == 1 ~ "Female",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    fetal_sex = factor(
      fetal_sex,
      levels = c(
        "Female",
        "Male"
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r}
pathwayss_to_plot <- unique(
  all_sig_final$feature
)

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  filter(
    feature %in% pathwayss_to_plot
  )

taxonomy_labels <- all_sig_final %>%
  select(
    feature,
    description
  ) %>%
  distinct()

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  left_join(
    taxonomy_labels,
    by = "feature"
  )
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# 5. Violin plots for each pathways
# ============================================================

pdf(
  file = file.path(
    plotdir,
    "pathways_sex_adjusted_violin_per_trimester.pdf"
  ),
  width = 10,
  height = 5
)

for (cur_feature in unique(plot_data$feature)) {

  plot_df <- plot_data %>%
    filter(
      feature == cur_feature
    )

  tax_name <- unique(
    na.omit(plot_df$description)
  )

  if (length(tax_name) > 0) {
    plot_title <- paste0(
      cur_feature,
      " - ",
      tax_name[1]
    )
  } else {
    plot_title <- cur_feature
  }

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(
      x = fetal_sex,
      y = abundance_adjusted,
      fill = fetal_sex
    )
  ) +
    geom_violin(
      trim = FALSE,
      alpha = 0.6
    ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.12,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.08,
      size = 1.5,
      alpha = 0.5
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ trimester,
      nrow = 1
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "",
      y = "EGA-adjusted abundance",
      title = plot_title
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = 12
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 11
      ),
      axis.title.y = element_text(
        size = 13
      ),
      strip.text = element_text(
        size = 12
      ),
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 12
      )
    )

  print(p)
}

dev.off()
```
